title.heading: STOP
title.text:
One touch stops the bench.
A 2s hold resets it.

labels.title: STOP
labels.text: Top right of every screen, in the band.

say.text: This video shows how stop works on the R C bench.
Stop sits at the top right of every screen.

steps.title: A motor runs
steps.text: The bench is ARMED. A motor runs at 64% throttle.
steps.say: Step 1. The bench is armed and a motor runs at 64 percent throttle.

steps.title: It acts on the press
steps.text: The finger is still on STOP. The bench is already SAFE and every output is off.
steps.say: It acts on the press. The finger is still down, and the bench is already safe.

steps.title: Release
steps.text: Lift the finger. Nothing changes: STOPPED stays in its yellow frame and the chip reads STOP.
steps.say: Release. Nothing changes. The stop is latched.

steps.title: Stopped and latched
steps.text: Every output is off: motor and servo outputs, the PD mini output and the programming ports' 5V.
steps.say: Every output is off: the motor and servo outputs, the P D mini output, and the 5 volts of the programming ports.

steps.title: ARM is refused
steps.say: Step 2. While stop is latched, tap arm.

steps.title: ARM is refused
steps.text: ARM, OUTPUT ON, PROG 5V ON and the start of a test or a limit run are refused. An arm does not clear this stop.
steps.say: The bench refuses. Arm, output on, the programming ports' 5 volts and the start of a run all stay refused.

steps.title: A short touch
steps.say: Step 3. The reset is a hold. Press stop again

steps.title: A short touch
steps.text: The fill starts to fade from red to yellow.
steps.say: and let go after half a second.

steps.title: Released before 2s
steps.text: Nothing is reset: Hold 2s to reset the STOP.
steps.say: Nothing is reset, and the bench says so.

steps.title: Hold 2s
steps.text: Hold STOP for 2s with one unbroken contact. The fill fades from red to the frame's yellow.
steps.say: Hold stop for two seconds, with one unbroken contact.

steps.title: The bench checks
steps.text: The panel waits until the IOmcu reports every output off, at least 500ms after the last STOP.
steps.say: The panel waits until the I O M C U reports every output off.

steps.title: Reset
steps.text: Release. The chip reads SAFE. The bench stays SAFE: ARM, OUTPUT ON and PROG 5V ON each need their own hold.
steps.say: Release. The stop is reset and the bench stays safe. Arm and every output need their own hold again.

steps.title: The stop button
steps.text: With SETUP › PANEL › Hardware stop ON, the bench's stop button shows as HWSTOP. It opens the heartbeat line: the IOmcu is SAFE and refuses ARM.
steps.say: Step 4. The bench's own stop button opens the heartbeat line to the I O M C U. The chip reads hardware stop, and the I O M C U is safe and refuses arm.

steps.title: Release it
steps.text: Release the button. HWSTOP goes 80 to 180ms after the line closes. The bench stays SAFE: hold ARM for 2s.
steps.say: Release the button, and the chip goes. The bench stays safe until arm is held for two seconds.

scenes.heading: STOP
items: One touch: SAFE, every output off
Latched: ARM and every ON refused
After the reset: SAFE, each output needs its hold
A restart of the panel comes up unlatched and SAFE
scenes.say: One touch stops the bench. A two second hold resets it, and nothing switches on by itself.
